title: Great app!
body: I have ADHD & all the other habit trackers I have tried make it hard to stick. The fact I can just interact with my habits via the widget feature makes things easy in fun. Not to mention it’s really affordable & easy to use! Great job ^_^ so happy I found this hidden gem!
author: tashabbygirl

title: On point
body: The app is really on point. I still need some more time on it to see how it goes. Would be really useful to have a widget for it, so I won’t have to open the app every time.
author: Ahmed Tahqiq
